body: Agree ako kay Bea na deployment breadth ang test, pero may mas basic gate pa: measurement quality. Kahit impressive ang AI layer, weak ang claim kung hindi malinaw ang calibration, uncertainty, drift at ground truth used to judge false calls. Sa metrology, a confident model cannot rescue a questionable measurement chain. So bago itanong ‘ilang sites na?’, itanong muna ‘how do you know the signal is right?’ That answer separates instrumentation engineering from AI decoration.

claims.text: Reliable calibration, uncertainty control and ground-truth validation are prerequisite evidence for trusting AI claims built on metrology data.
claims.basis: Engineering inference from the article's focus on analytical measurement, metrology and AI integration
